long_text_with_reference.typst_text: The meteorological tower was installed at the proposed wind farm site in January 2023. Data collection began in February and continued through December of the same year. The tower is equipped with instruments at multiple heights: 30m, 50m, 80m, and 100m above ground level. See \ref{fig-site-layout} for the tower configuration. Wind speed was measured using cup anemometers at all heights, while wind direction was measured using wind vanes at 50m and 80m. Temperature and pressure sensors were installed at 2m height. All instruments were calibrated before installation and checked monthly for drift.
